name: pathista
description: Runs the user's own multi-step workflows one step at a time in chat. Each run keeps its position, variables and history in the user's Pathista account.

capabilities: Start a run of a workflow
Read the current step of a run
Advance a run along an edge
Set run variables, notes and todos
Show run progress as a graph
Read, validate, create and edit workflows
defaultPrompt: Start my event campaign workflow in Pathista
Where is my current Pathista run?
